description: Look up a specific church by name (optionally with city) to answer questions like 'what is Watermark Church in Dallas like?', 'what does this church believe?', or 'where can I watch their sermons?'. Returns denomination, worship style, size, ministries, Google rating and review summary, website, YouTube channel, latest sermon video, statement of faith, and similar churches nearby.

churchName.description: Church name, e.g. 'Saddleback Church', 'Gateway Church', 'Redeemer Presbyterian'

city.description: City, to pick the right campus

name: get_church_details
title: Get details about a specific church
